column1: # Ribovore *DuplicateRegion filter: blastn null score thresholds (alpha 0.05)
# Read by ribo_DupfilterNullLoad() in ribo.pm. Do not edit by hand: a change to the
# blastn parameters requires regenerating the whole table.
# For each cell (lq, ls, at_bin), 500 pairs of iid random sequences were
# generated, a query of length lq and a subject of length ls (lq <= ls), with
# P(A) = P(T) = at_bin/2 and P(G) = P(C) = (1-at_bin)/2, and compared with one
# blastn call each using the parameters below. The statistic is the maximum HSP bit
# score (0 if there is no HSP). t05 is the threshold T such that an observed score
# x is significant at alpha = 0.05 if and only if x > T, where
# p = (number of null scores >= x, plus 1) / (N + 1).
# Each cell's random number generator (Python random.Random) was seeded with a
# fixed pseudo-random seed derived from the cell coordinates (lq, ls, at_bin).
# The table was built with blastn 2.11.0+.
# Lookup (see ribo_DupfilterNullLookupCell()): lq and ls are the shorter and longer
# extract lengths, and at_bin is max(AT, 1-AT) of the two extracts together; each is
# rounded UP to the next grid value, and lq is raised further if needed so that
# ls <= max_ratio * lq. Extracts longer than the largest grid length are not covered.
# built: Thu Sep 24 15:06:00 2026
# trials_per_cell: 500
# alpha: 0.05
# blastn_params: -task blastn -word_size 4 -dust no -soft_masking false -evalue 1000000 -reward 2 -penalty -3 -gapopen 5 -gapextend 2
# max_ratio: 4
# lq
